title: Coverage Lapses and the Driver Addition Loyalty Credit, Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Rating Note
content:
The loyalty credit in a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy driver addition charge is taken in a continuous-coverage share. That share follows the lapse marker on the policy record. A cancellation effective date kept on a reinstated policy marks a lapse in coverage.

## Rule

1. With no lapse marker on the policy record, the whole credit is taken (share of one).
2. With a lapse marker dated 36 months or more before the day the charge is booked, half of it is taken (share of 0.5).
3. With a lapse marker dated less than 36 months before that day, none of it is taken (share of nil).

## Boundary illustration (hypothetical; charge booked 1 October 2026)

| Lapse marker dated | Months before booking | Share |
|---|---|---|
| None | not applicable | One |
| 1 October 2023 | 36 | 0.5 |
| 1 November 2023 | 35 | Nil |
| 1 March 2020 | 79 | 0.5 |

A share of 0.5 takes half of the loyalty credit, a share of one the whole of it, and a share of nil none of it.
